name: Scientific Computing Programmer
description: Implement numerical methods, simulations, and high-performance computing kernels. Work with linear algebra, differential equations, and parallel algorithms.
example_snippet:
program MatrixMult:
    action multiply takes A as raw handle to fractional number, B as raw handle to fractional number, 
                      C as raw handle to fractional number, N as whole number produces nothing:
        repeat N times using I:
            repeat N times using J:
                keep Sum as fractional number with value 0.0
                repeat N times using K:
                    keep AVal as fractional number
                    put Index at the sum of the product of I and N and K of A into AVal
                    keep BVal as fractional number
                    put Index at the sum of the product of K and N and J of B into BVal
                    put the sum of Sum and the product of AVal and BVal into Sum
                end repeat
                put Sum into Index at the sum of the product of I and N and J of C
            end repeat
        end repeat
    end action

    keep N as whole number with value 3
    keep A as raw handle to fractional number with room for the product of N and N and 8
    keep B as raw handle to fractional number with room for the product of N and N and 8
    keep C as raw handle to fractional number with room for the product of N and N and 8

    call multiply with A and B and C and N
    print the text "Matrix multiplication complete" and newline
end program
